title.rendered: What software platforms are supported for your commercial packages?

content.rendered: At http://packages.ntop.org you can find binary packages we build for a few platforms (both stable and development versions). While we support all these platforms as best as we can, our prime platform is Ubuntu LTS (better if the latest version available). This means that not all packages are available for all platforms, but if you embrace Ubuntu LTS you can have the best experience as all packages are supported.
